omanyte-brine.name: Brine
omanyte-brine.description: Bond skill: a blast of brine at a foe up to 3 hexes away (Power 85).

omanyte-rollout.name: Rollout
omanyte-rollout.description: Bond skill: rolls up to 2 hexes in its shell (Power 65, Attack), engaging the foe.

omanyte-shell-smash.name: Shell Smash
omanyte-shell-smash.description: Bond skill: breaks its shell open, becoming Focused and Hasted for 2 turns.

omanyte-shell-armor.name: Shell Armor
omanyte-shell-armor.description: Takes 20% less damage while at full HP.

omanyte-ancient-hunter.name: Ancient Hunter
omanyte-ancient-hunter.description: Deals 20% more damage to Slowed foes.

omanyte-constrict.name: Constrict
omanyte-constrict.description: New skill: wraps a foe in its tentacles (Power 40) and engages it.

omanyte-bubble.name: Bubble
omanyte-bubble.description: New skill: a spray of bubbles at a foe up to 2 hexes away (Power 50); Slows 1 turn.

omanyte-tentacle-grip.name: Tentacle Grip
omanyte-tentacle-grip.description: Foes it engages always draw its free strike when leaving, even if they disengage.

omanyte-spiked-shell.name: Spiked Shell
omanyte-spiked-shell.description: Foes that hit it from an adjacent hex take 6 damage.

omanyte-muddy-water.name: Muddy Water
omanyte-muddy-water.description: New skill: a wave of muddy water on a 1-hex area up to 1 hex away (Power 65).

omanyte-protect.name: Protect
omanyte-protect.description: New skill: withdraws into its shell and is Protected for 2 turns.

omanyte-hunting-tentacles.name: Hunting Tentacles
omanyte-hunting-tentacles.description: Deals 15% more damage to foes engaged with one of its allies.

omanyte-sealed-shell.name: Sealed Shell
omanyte-sealed-shell.description: Heals 3% more max HP per turn while engaged.

omanyte-scald.name: Scald
omanyte-scald.description: New skill: scalding water at a foe up to 2 hexes away (Power 80); Burns 1 turn.

omanyte-rock-slide.name: Rock Slide
omanyte-rock-slide.description: New skill: hurls boulders on a 1-hex area up to 1 hex away (Power 75).

omanyte-tentacle-lash.name: Tentacle Lash
omanyte-tentacle-lash.description: Foes it engages take 25% more damage from its allies; its free strikes deal 20% more.

omanyte-barnacle-hide.name: Barnacle Hide
omanyte-barnacle-hide.description: Sheds statuses foes put on it at the start of its turn.

omanyte-power-gem.name: Power Gem
omanyte-power-gem.description: New skill: a ray of gleaming light at a foe up to 2 hexes away (Power 90).

omanyte-rock-blast.name: Rock Blast
omanyte-rock-blast.description: New skill: hurls rocks at a foe up to 2 hexes away (Power 80); leaves it Exposed 1 turn.

omanyte-spike-volley.name: Spike Volley
omanyte-spike-volley.description: Deals 20% more damage to foes 2+ hexes away.

omanyte-ancient-instinct.name: Ancient Instinct
omanyte-ancient-instinct.description: Each knockout it lands gives the team 1 Bond.

omanyte-ancient-tide.name: Ancient Tide
omanyte-ancient-tide.description: Capstone. Its Water and Rock moves deal 20% more damage.

omanyte-shell-fortress.name: Shell Fortress
omanyte-shell-fortress.description: Capstone. Takes 15% less damage; survives one knockout blow per battle at 1 HP.
